svg.title: AI SDLC reduced portfolio delivery cycles by 67 percent while improving recovery and scaling across approximately 280 teams
svg.desc: Anonymous enterprise case study showing the challenge of making AI work consistently across hundreds of teams, the addition of simple context and harness layers to a commercial AI engineering product, governed portfolio rollout, and measured delivery and quality benefits.
svg.text: A commercial AI product scaled through company context, delivery controls and governed execution
Business and application context rebuilt by team
Common workflows and approvals across ~280 teams, 40 programs
Common checks, security controls, approval evidence
The enterprise turned a commercial AI product into a repeatable delivery system for ~280 teams
